R0265.title: Freight-Rate Rule Arbitrage
R0265.definition: Exploiting mismatches in freight-rate segments, weight tiers, and vehicle-type tiers to claim freight differentials and discounts.
R0265.description:
Freight-rate rule arbitrage exploits boundary mismatches in rate segments, weight tiers, vehicle-type tiers, or discount rules to claim freight differentials and discounts via order splitting, weight alteration, or segment changes.

The risk causes freight-differential and discount losses and distorts rate and billing data. Detection must combine rate-rule consistency validation, billing tamper-proofing, and abnormal billing monitoring for reconciliation and recovery.
R0265.influence: The risk causes freight-differential and discount losses, distorts rate and billing data, and may trigger rate-fairness disputes.
